Author: Meowick
Name: Emote Plugin
Punchline: Manage and use custom emotes with Penumbra mod integration.
Description: An emote management plugin with Penumbra mod association. Add/remove/rename/duplicate emotes, auto-toggle Penumbra mods, search and organize your emote collection. Use /emotes to open.
Changelog: Multi-command emotes with aliases and defaults, detect commands from mods, inline mod settings editor, emote slot conflict warnings, import/export with mod remapping, quick access sub-commands and polish, What's New window.
